objectives.text: Follow the sunken causeway into Floodmill.
Speak with Lyra overlooking the drowned village.
Inspect the Floodmill census stone in the village square.
Examine the broken watermill on the east bank.
Redirect sluice channels to drain the archive path.
Cross the drained causeway and enter the Forgotten Archive.
Gather 3 damaged records and reconstruct the ledger (0/3).
Read the restored ledger to uncover the villagers' fate.
Restore the Second Ancient Beacon at the sanctuary.
Listen to Elena's recorded message at the Second Beacon.
Speak with Lyra at the sanctuary to unlock Ironwatch Keep.

lyra.speaker: HISTORIAN LYRA
before_entry: Hold a moment, Aren—inspect the sunken entrance arch first to orient Elena's hydro-compass.
arrival: LYRA: "Look down at the rooftops sticking through the reeds, Aren. No storm drowned this basin—someone lowered the flood-weirs decades ago and scrubbed the parish off every road map."
AREN: "There's a census plinth still standing in the lower square."
LYRA: "Let's walk through the deserted lanes and inspect that census stone together. I want to see how many hearths the kingdom pretended never existed."
explore_village: Walk into the mossy square north-east of here and examine the carved Floodmill Census Stone. Take in the deserted cottages too—even their doorplates were chiseled blank.
watermill_search: No names left on any lintel, and look east—the Old Watermill's wheel hangs snapped in its raceway. Go inspect the broken watermill mechanism first so we know which gears are missing.
watermill_parts: Check the millwright's maintenance diagram beside the east wall, then recover all three components: the Iron Drive Gear, Bronze Pinion, and Oak Coupling Belt.
watermill_ready: We have all three parts! Follow the millwright's diagram at the broken watermill: Seat the IRON DRIVE GEAR, mesh the BRONZE PINION, and loop the OAK COUPLING BELT.
sluice_search: Hear that rumble? The millwheel is turning the pump shaft again! Head north to the Canal Sluice Console and inspect how the floodwaters seal off the western archive causeway.
sluice_ready: Check the canal depth gauge on the south bank, then set the three sluice gates: WEST WEIR to DIVERT, CENTER LOCK to DRAIN, and EAST SPILLWAY to OPEN.
archive_search: The floodwaters dropped off the stone steps! Walk north across the drained causeway into the Forgotten Archive building beyond the canal.
archive_clues: Three water-stained archive records survived on these shelves and desks. Gather all three fragments before reconstructing the Master Village Ledger at the center table.
ledger_ready: Three fragments from three different desks—they fit right into the missing columns of the ledger! Bind the truth at the central ledger table: THIRTY-SIX HEARTHS, MEMORY OFFERING, and IRONWATCH SEAL.
truth_reveal: Wait—the wax binding opened cleanly. Examine the restored Master Ledger on the center table to read the full truth behind Floodmill's disappearance.
beacon_ready: LYRA: "Thirty-six families didn't flee, Aren. Their names were bound into the Great Bell's ward—we have to rekindle the Second Ancient Beacon north-east of here before stone forgets too."
echo_ready: Look at the crystal atop the Second Beacon—another memory ripple from Elena is waking! Touch the beacon core again to hear her message.
finale: LYRA: "If Ironwatch Keep holds the evacuation edicts, then someone living still profits from hiding that ledger."
AREN: "Mother stayed on this trail to prove the beacons could replace the bell's price. Let's take the eastern pass to Ironwatch Keep."
LYRA: "Stay close, mapmaker. Whatever awaits behind those basalt gates, we face Chapter 3 together."
completed: The Second Ancient Beacon burns steady above the marshes, and the eastern road to Ironwatch Keep stands unlocked ahead.

floodmill_entry: Cold marsh mist curls over sunken flagstones as Briarwood's pines give way to flooded timber roofs and silent willow boughs.
Ahead by the broken causeway lantern stands Lyra, comparing Elena's brass compass against a settlement missing from every royal atlas.
village_monument: FLOODMILL CENSUS STONE: "Parish of Floodmill—Wait..." Every carved family name beneath the heading has been ground flat with a cold chisel, leaving only blank stone hollows.
Beside the ruined east bank rises the silhouette of the Old Watermill, its timber wheel jammed above a choked millstream.
homestead_locket_note: WEAVER'S HOMESTEAD LOCKET: A tarnished silver locket pinned under a mossy floorboard holds two tiny painted portraits—with both names scraped out of the silver band.
AREN: "Someone took time to scratch away even a child's keepsake after the village fell silent."
watermill_inspect: BROKEN WATERMILL: The main axle housing stands stripped of its drive gear, intermediate pinion, and coupling belt. Until the millwheel drives the canal pump, the northern sluice console has no pressure.
Three salvageable millwright components lie scattered near the village cart, south millpond barrels, and central square fence.
mill_diagram_clue: MILLWRIGHT MAINTENANCE DIAGRAM: "Main Wheel Coupling—Slot 1 Drive Axle: IRON DRIVE GEAR. Slot 2 Center Mesh: BRONZE PINION. Slot 3 Sluice Shaft: OAK COUPLING BELT."
A handwritten margin note reads: "Never force a warped cog onto the main axle—the sluice pump relies on bronze-to-iron cadence."
sluice_inspect: CANAL SLUICE CONSOLE: Heavy iron handwheels control three brick weirs across the Floodmill canal. Right now the center lock backs floodwater deep over the Forgotten Archive causeway.
Read the stone Canal Depth Gauge just west of here, then align the West Weir, Center Lock, and East Spillway to lower the archive road to 0 cubits.
canal_gauge_clue: BRASS CANAL DEPTH GAUGE: "Flood Protocol for Archive Access—1. Set WEST WEIR to DIVERT silt water. 2. Set CENTER LOCK to DRAIN the stone steps. 3. Throw EAST SPILLWAY OPEN into the mill tailrace."
Beneath the brass plate, scratch marks confirm the Archive path drains completely only under DIVERT - DRAIN - OPEN.
archive_entry: THE FORGOTTEN ARCHIVE: Heavy stone columns support a damp upper library gallery where oak bookcases sag over candlelit reading tables.
Across the desks lie three surviving parchment fragments torn from Floodmill's last official ledger. Collect all three records before reconstructing the Master Ledger.
record_census: TORN PARISH ROLL (RECORD 1/3): "By autumn of the hundredth year of the Great Bell, thirty-six hearths burned cleanly in Floodmill before the thirteenth toll."
ENTRY TAG: Pair 'Entry I: The Census' with THIRTY-SIX HEARTHS.
record_tribute: ASH-STAINED DECREE (RECORD 2/3): "Under quiet Bellhaven writ, Floodmill's parish names were struck from register and speech as a collective MEMORY OFFERING to mend the northern fracture."
ENTRY TAG: Pair 'Entry II: The Edict' with MEMORY OFFERING.
record_transfer: LOCKBOX RECEIPT (RECORD 3/3): "Original signed evacuation charters sealed and carried northeast up the valley road under the IRONWATCH SEAL."
ENTRY TAG: Pair 'Entry III: The Vault' with IRONWATCH SEAL.
villagers_truth: RESTORED VILLAGE LEDGER: As the final column locks into place, ink ghosts flare briefly across the parchment—names of millers, weavers, and children erased in a single winter so the rest of Ashvale would keep forgetting.
ELENA'S FIELD MARGINALIA: "Floodmill did not empty from flood or famine. The Second Beacon north of this archive holds my recorded proof."
second_beacon_activation: Brilliant amber-cyan light erupts up the mossy sanctuary monolith as the Second Ancient Beacon answers Briarwood's flame across the darkened valley.
Within the humming lantern prism, another preserved imprint of Elena's voice flickers to life.
elena_recording_ch2: ELENA'S ECHO: "They did not vanish because the world forgot them."
ELENA'S ECHO: "They vanished because someone made the world forget."
AREN: "Then the bell isn't saving us."
LYRA: "It may be saving some of us. We need to know who paid the price."
Elena's echo points northeast toward the basalt keep guarding the mountain road—the truth behind who ordered the sacrifice lies inside Ironwatch Keep. Speak with Lyra by the sanctuary.
